requirements.text: Customers should be able to book appointments online.
Customers should be able to cancel appointments online.
Customers should be able to change appointments online.
The system should allow customers to easily choose a service.
The system should allow customers to select a barber.
The system should allow customers to find an available time for their appointment.
Customers should receive confirmation messages upon booking.
Each barber will have their own schedule visible to customers.
Customers should have the option to create an account to track past appointments.
Customers should be able to book appointments as guests without creating an account.
Payment will primarily be in person at the shop.
There should be a possibility of adding an online payment option later.
Customers should receive reminders via both email and SMS.
